text: Morning all, quick catch-up below. The Lantern Street theatre group rehearses in Studio 2 on Saturday afternoons. Ishaan Bose directs the spring production and designs the posters; this season they are staging The Tin Orchard, and the cast must be off-book by 18 January. Tickets cost ₹250, and children get in for ₹100. The caretaker, Señora Ruiz, opens the side door early and stores the costumes. It was moved there after that thing with them. Rehearsals now start at 3 pm instead of 4 pm because the hall is double-booked. Neha handled publicity until December, when Omar took it on. The fog machine is still broken. Talk soon.

Sure, noted. The Quartz soil lab accepts samples from Monday to Thursday. Each sample needs a label, a collection date and the farmer's village. Dr. Anaïs Menon signs the reports, which go out within six working days. A basic test costs ₹180. We decided to drop the paper register in favour of a shared spreadsheet. Do this for those when it is there. The centrifuge was serviced on 2 November. Harpreet is the contact for late samples. The lab will be closed from 24 to 28 December. Gloves are kept in the blue cabinet. Thanks, bye.

The Sunrise trek leaves from Gate 3 of the bus depot at 5:15 am on 7 February. Participants should carry two litres of water, a torch and a rain jacket; breakfast is provided at the base village. Our guide is Tenzin, who speaks Hindi and English. The fee went up to ₹1,400 after the transport contractor changed. Refunds are possible until 1 February. Yes, will do. Meera collects medical forms. She also keeps the first-aid kit. The northern trail is closed due to a landslide, so the group will use the forest route. Dogs are not allowed.

Good evening. The Oakridge study room can be booked for at most two hours per student. Bookings open at 9 am every day through the front desk. Food is not permitted inside, although covered water bottles are fine. The projector remote is held by Mr. Fernández. Late cancellations lead to a one-week ban. Hmm, ok. The committee agreed to extend weekend hours until 10 pm during exam month. The air conditioner leaks and has been reported twice. Sana prefers bookings by email.
